description: 25-prompt family trip planning eval dataset for SproutRoute AI assistant skill assessment across 7 travel planning categories. Context injected via context_blocks.

prompts.prompt: Plan a 3-day trip to {{destination}} for a {{family_composition}} with kids ages {{kid_ages}}. Include one kid-friendly activity per morning and afternoon, plus restaurant recommendations for each meal.

context_blocks.destination: San Diego, CA
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Sunny, highs 72-75F, lows 58-60F, no rain expected.
context_blocks.preferences: Kids love animals and the beach. No seafood allergies. Budget: moderate.

prompts.prompt: Create a weekend itinerary in {{destination}} for a {{family_composition}} with a {{kid_ages}} year old. We want a mix of outdoor and indoor activities in case of rain.

context_blocks.destination: Nashville, TN
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Partly cloudy, highs 78-80F, 40% chance of afternoon showers Saturday.
context_blocks.preferences: Child loves music and animals. Parents enjoy live music. Budget: moderate to high.

prompts.prompt: Build a 5-day family vacation itinerary for {{destination}} for a {{family_composition}} with kids ages {{kid_ages}}. The toddler needs a nap from 1-3 PM daily. Include drive times between activities and suggest backup indoor options for each day.

context_blocks.destination: Orlando, FL
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Hot and humid, highs 90-93F, daily afternoon thunderstorms likely 3-5 PM.
context_blocks.preferences: Mix of theme parks and non-park days. Toddler nap 1-3 PM is non-negotiable. Budget: high.

prompts.prompt: Plan a 4-day road trip from {{destination}} for a {{family_composition}} with kids ages {{kid_ages}}. Include recommended stop points every 2 hours, kid-friendly roadside attractions, and overnight hotel suggestions in each city.

context_blocks.destination: Chicago, IL to Mackinac Island, MI (approx 5-hour drive)
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Warm, highs 82-86F, scattered storms possible July 5.
context_blocks.preferences: Kids get restless after 90 minutes in the car. Need frequent stops. Interested in nature and history.

prompts.prompt: Design a 7-day multi-destination trip covering {{destination}} for a {{family_composition}} with kids ages {{kid_ages}}. One child has ADHD and needs high-stimulation activities with minimal wait times. Include a daily energy budget rating (low/medium/high) and identify quiet wind-down activities for evenings.

context_blocks.destination: Washington DC, Philadelphia, and New York City
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Spring weather, highs 55-65F, rain likely March 30 and April 1.
context_blocks.preferences: 10-year-old has ADHD, needs engaging activities. 6-year-old tires easily. Parents want at least one adults-only dinner. Budget: high.

prompts.prompt: Create a 5-day itinerary for {{destination}} for a {{family_composition}} with kids ages {{kid_ages}}. The family is visiting grandparents who have limited mobility (wheelchair accessible venues only). Plan activities that work for ages 1 through 75, and include estimated costs for each day.

context_blocks.destination: Savannah, GA
context_blocks.family_composition: multigenerational family of 7 (two parents, three children, two grandparents)
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Pleasant fall weather, highs 76-80F, low humidity, no rain expected.
context_blocks.preferences: Grandfather uses wheelchair. Grandmother walks slowly. Baby needs stroller-friendly paths. Budget: moderate. Interested in history and nature.

prompts.prompt: Generate a packing checklist for a {{family_composition}} with a {{kid_ages}} year old going to {{destination}} for {{dates}}. Organize by person and category (clothing, toiletries, gear, entertainment).

context_blocks.destination: beach resort in Myrtle Beach, SC
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Hot and sunny, highs 88-92F, humid, UV index 9-10.
context_blocks.preferences: Toddler is potty training. Family plans to spend most time at beach and pool.

prompts.prompt: Create a packing list for a {{family_composition}} with kids ages {{kid_ages}} flying to {{destination}} on {{dates}}. We only have carry-on luggage (one bag per person). Prioritize essentials and suggest what to buy at the destination instead of packing.

context_blocks.destination: Denver, CO for a ski trip
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Cold, highs 28-35F, snow expected Feb 15-16.
context_blocks.preferences: Carry-on only. Will rent ski gear at resort. Kids have never skied before. One child gets cold easily.

prompts.prompt: Build a comprehensive packing list for a {{family_composition}} with a {{kid_ages}} month old baby traveling to {{destination}}. Include a separate 'diaper bag essentials' section for the plane and a 'do not forget' priority list of the top 10 most critical items.

context_blocks.destination: Portland, OR
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Mild, highs 70-75F, light rain possible on day 3.
context_blocks.preferences: Baby is formula-fed and starting solids. First flight with baby. Parents are anxious flyers.

prompts.prompt: Create a packing list for a {{family_composition}} with kids ages {{kid_ages}} going on a 10-day trip that includes {{destination}}. Account for multiple climates, laundry access mid-trip, and one child's sensory sensitivities (only wears soft cotton, no tags, specific shoe requirements).

context_blocks.destination: 3 days in Seattle (rainy, 55F), 4 days in Maui (sunny, 85F), 3 days in San Francisco (foggy, 62F)
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Seattle: rain likely. Maui: hot and sunny. San Francisco: cool fog mornings, warm afternoons.
context_blocks.preferences: 6-year-old has sensory processing issues: only soft tagless cotton, no sandals, needs noise-canceling headphones. Laundry available at Maui hotel only.

prompts.prompt: What car seat do I need for my {{kid_ages}} year old when we rent a car in {{destination}}? Include the state law requirements and whether I should bring our own or rent one.

context_blocks.destination: Florida
context_blocks.weather_forecast: N/A
context_blocks.preferences: Child is 36 inches tall, 32 lbs. Currently uses a convertible car seat at home. Flying into Orlando.

prompts.prompt: We are driving through {{destination}} with kids ages {{kid_ages}}. Summarize the car seat laws for each state we will pass through and flag any differences we need to prepare for.

context_blocks.destination: Virginia, North Carolina, South Carolina, and Georgia (road trip from DC to Atlanta)
context_blocks.weather_forecast: N/A
context_blocks.preferences: 2-year-old is rear-facing in convertible seat. 5-year-old is in a booster. Both children are average height/weight for age.

prompts.prompt: Provide a family travel safety briefing for {{destination}} with kids ages {{kid_ages}}. Include: nearest hospitals to our hotel area, common tourist scams to watch for, water safety tips, and an emergency contact card template we can print.

context_blocks.destination: Cancun, Mexico (staying in Hotel Zone)
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Warm, highs 82-85F, occasional brief rain showers.
context_blocks.preferences: First international trip with kids. Kids are strong swimmers but have never been in ocean waves. Parents speak basic Spanish.

prompts.prompt: Our {{kid_ages}} year old has a severe peanut allergy (carries EpiPen). Create a comprehensive safety plan for our trip to {{destination}} including: restaurant communication cards, nearest hospitals with pediatric ER, airline allergy protocols, and a step-by-step anaphylaxis response plan for each family member.

context_blocks.destination: Honolulu, Hawaii
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Warm, highs 80-84F, trade winds, brief showers possible.
context_blocks.preferences: Flying United Airlines from San Francisco. Staying in Waikiki. 5-year-old carries EpiPen Jr. Allergy is anaphylactic-level severe.

prompts.prompt: The forecast for our trip to {{destination}} on {{dates}} shows {{weather_forecast}}. What should we adjust in our outdoor plans, and what indoor backup activities do you recommend for the family?

context_blocks.destination: Gatlinburg, TN
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Day 1: sunny 62F. Day 2: heavy rain all day, high 48F, flash flood watch. Day 3: clearing, 58F with morning fog.
context_blocks.preferences: Planned hiking on Day 2 in Great Smoky Mountains. Kids enjoy crafts and aquariums.

prompts.prompt: We are visiting {{destination}} during {{dates}} and the forecast shows extreme heat. Redesign our day-by-day itinerary to avoid heat-related illness for our kids ages {{kid_ages}}. Include hydration reminders, shade strategy, and optimal timing for outdoor activities.

context_blocks.destination: Phoenix, AZ (Grand Canyon day trip planned)
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Extreme heat: highs 110-115F in Phoenix, 95-100F at Grand Canyon South Rim. UV index 11. No rain.
context_blocks.preferences: Grand Canyon day trip on Day 2 is non-negotiable. Toddler overheats easily. Family from Seattle, not acclimated to desert heat.

prompts.prompt: Our 7-day cruise departing from {{destination}} on {{dates}} has the following port-of-call forecasts: {{weather_forecast}}. For each port day, recommend whether to book the outdoor excursion or switch to an indoor alternative, considering we have kids ages {{kid_ages}} and one child gets severe motion sickness in rough seas.

context_blocks.destination: Miami, FL (Royal Caribbean cruise to Western Caribbean)
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Day 1 Miami: sunny 82F. Day 3 Cozumel: partly cloudy 84F, calm seas. Day 4 Grand Cayman: tropical storm warning, heavy rain, 6-8ft swells. Day 5 Jamaica: clearing, 80F, residual 4ft swells. Day 7 Miami return: sunny.
context_blocks.preferences: 10-year-old gets severe motion sickness. Planned: snorkeling Cozumel, beach day Grand Cayman, waterfall hike Jamaica. Parents want to maximize port time.

prompts.prompt: Find kid-friendly restaurants in {{destination}} that can accommodate our family's dietary needs: {{preferences}}. Suggest 3 options for each meal type (breakfast, lunch, dinner).

context_blocks.destination: Austin, TX
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Warm, highs 88F.
context_blocks.preferences: One parent is vegetarian. 4-year-old is a very picky eater (only eats plain pasta, chicken nuggets, fruit). 7-year-old has a dairy allergy (not severe, can have baked-in dairy). Looking for places with outdoor seating and a relaxed vibe.

prompts.prompt: We are a {{family_composition}} with kids ages {{kid_ages}} visiting {{destination}}. One child is gluten-free (celiac disease) and the other is going through a phase where they only eat 5 foods. Create a meal plan for each day that keeps both kids fed and happy, including grocery store recommendations for snack stocking.

context_blocks.destination: Yellowstone National Park area (staying in West Yellowstone, MT)
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Sunny, highs 75-80F, cool evenings around 45F.
context_blocks.preferences: 8-year-old has celiac disease (strict gluten-free). 4-year-old only eats: mac and cheese, hot dogs, applesauce, crackers, and grapes. Limited restaurant options near park. Have a cooler in the car.

prompts.prompt: Plan all meals for a 6-day trip to {{destination}} for our {{family_composition}} with kids ages {{kid_ages}}. Dietary constraints: kosher family (no mixing meat and dairy, only kosher-certified meat), one child has a tree nut allergy, and the baby is transitioning to solids. Include both restaurant and self-catering options.

context_blocks.destination: Los Angeles, CA (staying in Santa Monica)
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Sunny, highs 75-78F, coastal fog mornings.
context_blocks.preferences: Strictly kosher (separate meat and dairy, kosher-certified restaurants preferred). 4-year-old has tree nut allergy. 10-month-old starting solids (purees and soft finger foods). Vacation rental has a full kitchen.

prompts.prompt: Plan a 2-day visit to {{destination}} for our {{family_composition}} with kids ages {{kid_ages}}. List which rides are appropriate for each child by height, suggest the best time to arrive, and include a break/nap strategy.

context_blocks.destination: Walt Disney World Magic Kingdom, Orlando, FL
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Hot, highs 89F, afternoon thunderstorms likely 2-4 PM.
context_blocks.preferences: 3-year-old has never been to a theme park. 7-year-old loves roller coasters. Using stroller for the toddler. Have Genie+ but not Individual Lightning Lane.

prompts.prompt: Create an optimized touring plan for {{destination}} for a {{family_composition}} with kids ages {{kid_ages}}. One parent will stay with the toddler during thrill rides while the other takes the older kids. Include a rider switch strategy and show/parade schedule integration.

context_blocks.destination: Universal Studios and Islands of Adventure, Orlando, FL (2 parks, 2 days)
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Sunny, highs 84F, low chance of rain.
context_blocks.preferences: 11-year-old is a huge Harry Potter fan. 6-year-old is scared of dark rides. 2-year-old in stroller. Have Express Unlimited passes. Want to minimize walking distance.

prompts.prompt: We have 1 day at {{destination}} with a {{family_composition}} and kids ages {{kid_ages}}. One child uses a wheelchair. Create a minute-by-minute touring plan that maximizes ride count while using DAS (Disability Access Service), includes character meal reservations, and has a contingency plan for ride breakdowns.

context_blocks.destination: Disneyland Resort (Disneyland + California Adventure), Anaheim, CA
context_blocks.kid_ages: 5 (uses wheelchair due to muscular dystrophy, 42 inches tall) and 9
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Sunny, highs 72F, clear all day.
context_blocks.preferences: Only 1 day — must be efficient. 5-year-old qualifies for DAS. 9-year-old wants to ride every roller coaster. Want princess character dining. Park hopper tickets. Arriving at rope drop, staying until close.

prompts.prompt: We are a {{family_composition}} with kids ages {{kid_ages}} traveling from the US to {{destination}} on {{dates}}. Create a preparation checklist covering: passport/visa requirements for minors, recommended vaccinations, time zone adjustment strategy for the kids, currency tips, essential phrases to teach the children, and a cultural etiquette briefing for the family.

context_blocks.destination: Tokyo, Japan (10-day trip)
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Cold, highs 45-50F, dry. Possible snow late December.
context_blocks.preferences: First international trip for the kids. Flying from Los Angeles (17-hour time difference management needed). 5-year-old is a picky eater. 9-year-old is interested in Japanese culture and anime.

prompts.prompt: Plan a 14-day multi-country European trip for our {{family_composition}} with kids ages {{kid_ages}} covering {{destination}}. Include: border crossing logistics, car seat regulations in each country, health insurance considerations, SIM card/connectivity plan, kid-friendly transit strategies, and a realistic daily budget breakdown in local currencies.

context_blocks.destination: London (4 days), Paris (4 days), Barcelona (3 days), Rome (3 days)
context_blocks.weather_forecast: London: 65-72F, rainy. Paris: 72-80F, mostly sunny. Barcelona: 82-88F, sunny. Rome: 85-92F, hot and sunny.
context_blocks.preferences: Traveling by train between cities (Eurostar + TGV + high-speed rail). Baby in carrier/stroller. 5-year-old walks but tires after 30 min. 10-year-old interested in history. One parent speaks French, no other languages. Budget: moderate.
